natural: 25 Chance Encounters (stop at every white dot)
tips: Kill the Legendary Buck early and craft the Buck Antler Trinket before serious hunting: it makes perfect pelts far more likely.
Think about the Legend of the East satchel early. Its space makes herbs, cards and orchids much easier; without it, leave Herbalist 7 and 8 and the last cigarette cards for the Epilogue.
Egrets, herons and spoonbills respawn slowly where carcasses lie, so collect exotic plumes over many short visits.
Start Mrs Hobbs' hunting requests early and take target animals whenever you happen across them.
Six Point Cabin is the easy place for several Weapons Expert and Sharpshooter challenges, but it's gone after Goodbye, Dear Friend in Chapter 6.
Cash, consumables and horses are lost at the end of Chapter 6: buy any missing weapons and premium cigarettes before then.
Some things only come after Chapter 6: the graves, the last two gang hideouts, Herbalist 9 and 10, Horseman 9 and 10, and maximum cores (all challenges plus reinforced gear).
Gambler 8 (three blackjack wins with three or more hits) is pure luck. Set aside an hour or two.
